variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric the shepherd blew a peddler's sheep horn and called every wolf in the Ashwood down on his fold.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Oh, what have I done?! What have I done!

A peddler sold me a horn for calling my sheep home. I blew it once, and every wolf in the Ashwood came running down on my fold! These wolves will be the death of me!

Kill them, young sir. They lurk in the trees just behind my house. I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: I still hear that howling. You going?

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Not a howl out there! They're really gone?! Bless you!

Here, take this bow. And if you're headed north, see Halvard in the Moot Hall. He has worse trouble than mine.

journal.text: Find the wolves at Ulric's fold and drive them off.

variants.specifics: Krennack: Warden Toskel must by order of the Mining Council evict a Troll squatting in the old Counting House, and would rather anyone else did it.

offer.speaker: Toskel
offer.text:
Ahem. You there, stranger. The Mining Council has ordered that the Troll squatting in the old Counting House be evicted at once. As Warden, the duty falls to me.

I have the notice right here, signed and sealed. But that Troll is the biggest, smelliest lout ever to set foot in Krennack! Ever since the Ogres took the Great Lift, every brute in the mountain thinks he can just move in!

The Counting House is at the east end of town. Get that Troll out of there, by whatever means you like, and the Council will see you rewarded.

reminder.speaker: Toskel
reminder.text: It's not every day we get a Troll for a neighbor.

completion.speaker: Toskel
completion.text:
Excellent work! The Counting House is fit for honest folk again, and I never had to set one foot inside!

On behalf of the Mining Council, I present you with this shield. Wear it with pride!

journal.text: Evict the Troll squatting in the old Counting House.

variants.specifics: Skell: Thurlo, deathly afraid of leeches, sits on his roof since Giant Leeches nested under his hut.

offer.speaker: Thurlo
offer.text:
Up here! Up on the roof! Giant Leeches have crawled out of the swamp and nested under my hut! I can't stand the things! I'd sooner kiss an Ogre than feel one of those slimy bloodsuckers on me!

Ever since Vashtor came, the water's been crawling with them. The nest is under the floor, on the east side. Kill every last one and I'll make it worth your while! I'm not coming down till they're gone!

reminder.speaker: Thurlo
reminder.text: Those Leeches grow fat on warm blood, which they suck from the legs of anyone who wades in the black water underneath my poor hut.

completion.speaker: Thurlo
completion.text:
Oh, thank goodness! I can come down at last! You've saved my life, kind sir!

Here, take my leather boots as a token of my appreciation. I'm never setting foot in that water again!

journal.text: Find the nest under Thurlo's hut and kill the Leeches.

variants.specifics: Varrok: Gessa's bathhouse is ruined because a gang of Rogues from the old quarry steals all her soap and towels every night.

offer.speaker: Gessa
offer.text:
Thieves! Thieves in my bathhouse!

Every night a gang of Rogues creeps in and carries off all my soap and towels. Those miserable rascals will be the ruin of me! The soldiers stink to high heaven, and nobody pays for a bath without soap!

The Rogues hide out in the old quarry west of town. Run them off for good and I'll pay you handsomely.

reminder.speaker: Gessa
reminder.text: It is high time you got moving, lad, those Rogues get bolder every night.

completion.speaker: Gessa
completion.text:
Gone? The Rogues are really gone?! Oh, happy day! Tonight every soldier in Varrok gets a proper bath!

Here's 100 gold, as promised. You've saved my business, brave Adventurer!

variants.specifics: Kesk: Gribble, a fisherman who cannot abide leeches, wants the Giant Leeches cleared from the shallows by his nets.

offer.speaker: Gribble
offer.text:
Leeches! Giant Leeches! They've crawled up into the shallows where I keep my nets!

I can't abide the things. One look and I go weak at the knees! These slimy bloodsuckers will be the death of me!

A fisherman who can't go near the water... Please, kill them all. My nets are at the south end of the beach. I'll pay you well!

completion.speaker: Gribble
completion.text:
No more Leeches? Truly? Oh, bless you! I can go back to my nets!

Here, 100 gold pieces, just as I promised. You've saved a poor man's living, brave Adventurer.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches to free the nets of Gribble.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Master Pellock, a teacher at the College, wants the Wisps of Bramble Orchard destroyed: they burned off his beard while he napped.

offer.speaker: Pellock
offer.text:
Don't look at my chin! Don't you dare look at it!

Those Wisps from Bramble Orchard set my beard on fire while I was napping under the apple trees! Years to grow it, and gone in one puff! The students giggle every time I walk into class. These blasted Wisps are worse than a plague of rats!

Go out to the orchard, east of the College, and put out every last one of them. I'll pay you well.

completion.speaker: Pellock
completion.text:
The Wisps are gone? Ha! Now my beard can grow back in peace!

Thank you, stranger. Here are 100 gold pieces and a Spell Book. Spend them wisely!

journal.text: Go out to Bramble Orchard and destroy the Wisps.

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Hedda's Pa comes home from patrol tomorrow, and the White Wolves of the Ice Caves dragged off his lucky long johns from the east wall.

offer.speaker: Hedda
offer.text:
Kind sir! Kind sir, wait! I'm in terrible trouble! Pa's lucky long johns are gone! I hung them on the east wall to dry and a pack of White Wolves made off with them!

Pa comes home from patrol tomorrow and he won't stand a single watch without them. These mangy beasts are worse than a blizzard!

Please, go down to their den below the east wall and get rid of those wolves. I'll pay you well for it.

reminder.speaker: Hedda
reminder.text: One of the soldiers -- with a nasty cough -- says he saw those wolves slink into the caves under the wall. Maybe Pa's long johns are down there too!

completion.speaker: Hedda
completion.text:
You did it?! The wolves are really gone? And Pa's long johns too! Oh, thank you, thank you!

Here, take this gold, with my thanks. Pa will never know a thing!

journal.text: Clear the White Wolves out of the Ice Caves.

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Pelgrim, a smith, had his wig snatched off his head in the street by the Bats of the Old Smelter and wants them driven out.

offer.speaker: Pelgrim
offer.text:
Don't you laugh! Don't you dare laugh! I was walking home past the Old Smelter when a swarm of Bats came screeching out and snatched the wig clean off my head! In front of the whole street!

I'll never show my face at the forge again! They roost inside the place, west of the town well. Drive them out and I'll pay you handsomely.

reminder.speaker: Pelgrim
reminder.text: That roost of Bats is a curse beyond compare and will even pluck the hair right off an honest smith's head.

completion.speaker: Pelgrim
completion.text: My wig! You found my wig too! Oh, I'm a new man! Here -- 90 gold, as I promised.

journal.text: Drive the Bats from their roost in the Old Smelter.

variants.specifics: Torvel: Old Pell cannot use his outhouse: a Bear has come down from the hills and moved in.

offer.speaker: Pell
offer.text:
Help! Help! There's a Bear in my outhouse!

The big hairy brute came down out of the hills and squeezed himself inside, and he won't come out! It's the worst calamity ever to befall an old man!

My cottage is just west of the inn. Get that Bear out of there, brave Adventurer, and I'll make it worth your while!

reminder.speaker: Pell
reminder.text: You haven't got that Bear out of my outhouse!

completion.speaker: Pell
completion.text:
He's gone?! Really gone? Oh, thank goodness! I've been waiting all morning!

Here, take these Leather Boots as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Enter Pell's yard and chase off the Bear.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Hobart bought a farm cheap and found an Ogre living in the hayloft; he pays to have it driven out.

offer.speaker: Hobart
offer.text:
It's an outrage! I've been swindled!

I bought the farm east of the well for next to nothing, and nobody told me an Ogre lives in the hayloft! He eats my cabbages, he snores all night and he won't budge! That brute is worse than a hailstorm!

Get him out of my barn, stranger, and I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Hobart
reminder.text: Pick up whatever weapons you need from Krell the smith and come back when the hayloft is empty.

completion.speaker: Hobart
completion.text: You did it! The hayloft is empty at last! Here, take this Bow, it's yours. Go tell Mayor Quillon -- he said nobody could shift that Ogre!

journal.text:
Drive the Ogre out of Hobart's barn in order to earn a reward.

The Ogre is most likely asleep in the hayloft.
